key_values.event_name: Super Typhoon Yagi severe wind and rainfall impacts

primary_gt.canonical_stance: Yagi reaches the extreme compound wind-rain impact load class because all four tests score 3.
forbidden_claims: Do not use the elevated or limited class.
Do not claim outage, flood depth, building-level damage, or full landslide inventory.
required_claims: Impact scores 3: flood or landslide terms, 179 deaths, and 47,500 houses.

notes: Off-event gridded precipitation summaries are not required for the official rain score.
WorldPop and OpenStreetMap values are evaluated as package-relative exposure and public-service derived statistics, not as confirmed affected-population or outage counts.

criteria.description: Gives total score 12/12 and the class extreme compound wind-rain impact load.
criteria.name: Final score and load class
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for the correct top-band class with a missing or slightly misstated score; award 1 point for a correct high-load direction without the exact class.

criteria.description: Reports wind severity 3, rainfall severity 3, impact cascade 3, and public-service exposure load 3.
criteria.name: Component-score ledger
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for each correct component score, or up to 3 points for a correct total with one component mislabeled.

criteria.description: Uses the relevant wind and rainfall anchors, including 213 km/h or 125+ mph winds and reported rainfall at or above 250 mm.
criteria.name: Wind and rainfall anchors
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for correct threshold logic with incomplete or approximate values.

criteria.description: Connects flooding or landslides with at least 179 deaths, over 47,500 damaged or destroyed houses, population above 1,000,000, and 89 critical/public-service amenities.
criteria.name: Impact and exposure anchors
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for including only impact anchors or only exposure anchors, or for using correct thresholds without exact values.

criteria.description: Shows that 3 + 3 + 3 + 3 = 12 and maps 12 to the 10-12 top band.
criteria.name: Index arithmetic and class mapping
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for correct arithmetic without the class mapping, or correct class mapping with one arithmetic slip.

criteria.description: Ties the top-band result to combined wind, rain, reported-loss, population, and public-service indicators without a broad disaster narrative.
criteria.name: Concise computed interpretation
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for a generic interpretation that is only partly tied to the computed values.

criteria.description: Keeps the answer concise, follows the requested format, and avoids extra-data claims beyond the index values.
criteria.name: Scope and answer discipline
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 points if the answer is mostly concise but includes minor extra-data or off-format material.
